svg.title: tsrs vs bun check vs tsgo
svg.desc: Summed over 17 TypeScript projects · 4 threads each · 16-vCPU Linux machine. Check time: tsrs 12.1 s, bun check 36.2 s, tsgo 80.2 s. Peak memory: tsrs 12.6 GiB, bun check 15.3 GiB, tsgo 53.5 GiB. Shorter is better. Per project: vscode: tsrs 2.21 s, 1.80 GiB; bun check 4.41 s, 1.50 GiB; tsgo 10.77 s, 7.56 GiB. xstate-main: tsrs 0.16 s, 0.24 GiB; bun check 0.30 s, 0.30 GiB; tsgo 0.83 s, 0.73 GiB. webpack: tsrs 0.27 s, 0.40 GiB; bun check 0.50 s, 0.37 GiB; tsgo 1.30 s, 1.15 GiB. mui-docs: tsrs 1.01 s, 1.05 GiB; bun check 9.23 s, 5.33 GiB; tsgo 12.40 s, 7.54 GiB. Compiler: tsrs 0.06 s, 0.10 GiB; bun check 0.11 s, 0.12 GiB; tsgo 0.28 s, 0.21 GiB. Compiler-Unions: tsrs 0.10 s, 0.10 GiB; bun check 0.21 s, 0.13 GiB; tsgo 0.54 s, 0.24 GiB. cal-diy: tsrs 0.99 s, 1.14 GiB; bun check 3.06 s, 0.92 GiB; tsgo 5.48 s, 4.41 GiB. formbricks-web: tsrs 1.13 s, 1.45 GiB; bun check 2.37 s, 1.33 GiB; tsgo 7.17 s, 5.83 GiB. supabase-studio: tsrs 1.25 s, 1.19 GiB; bun check 3.61 s, 0.89 GiB; tsgo 6.99 s, 4.85 GiB. t3code-server: tsrs 1.52 s, 1.18 GiB; bun check 3.50 s, 1.01 GiB; tsgo 13.54 s, 6.17 GiB. mikro-orm: tsrs 1.58 s, 1.38 GiB; bun check 4.92 s, 0.76 GiB; tsgo 10.62 s, 6.38 GiB. next-packages-next: tsrs 0.46 s, 0.55 GiB; bun check 0.95 s, 0.50 GiB; tsgo 2.86 s, 1.79 GiB. next-root: tsrs 0.30 s, 0.40 GiB; bun check 0.62 s, 0.41 GiB; tsgo 1.56 s, 1.28 GiB. storybook: tsrs 0.27 s, 0.39 GiB; bun check 0.54 s, 0.45 GiB; tsgo 1.63 s, 1.41 GiB. nuxt: tsrs 0.24 s, 0.38 GiB; bun check 0.69 s, 0.40 GiB; tsgo 1.29 s, 1.16 GiB. playwright: tsrs 0.23 s, 0.34 GiB; bun check 0.45 s, 0.37 GiB; tsgo 1.19 s, 1.05 GiB. drizzle-orm: tsrs 0.27 s, 0.50 GiB; bun check 0.75 s, 0.53 GiB; tsgo 1.76 s, 1.74 GiB. tsgo and tsrs with --checkers 4, bun check with --threads 4. Median of 10 interleaved runs (3 for tsgo). tsrs uses PGO-optimized dist build, built like the npm release binaries. Machine: Depot CI depot-ubuntu-24.04-16 (16 vCPU, 63 GB RAM, Linux x86_64, AMD EPYC 9R45 96-Core Processor). Measured 2026-10-16 06:30 UTC; tsrs commit 9ef0a57762d4e2030b24ea0edb52166e56bfc21d. TypeScript 7.0.2; TypeScript reference b85298b6a81f772d080b0455de0ca9d744cd6fd6.
